collision_boundary.C306: killed multi-walker path avoidance, not a homogeneous Cayley-tree group walk
collision_boundary.C333: finite-graph randomized gossip consensus, not an infinite-tree spectral walk
collision_boundary.C341: lamplighter walk on a finite cycle has a wreath-product lamp state and finite spectrum, not free-group escape

model.operator: P=A/D on the D-regular Cayley tree

nonclaims: no local limit theorem or sharp asymptotic prefactor beyond the stated exact return law
no nonuniform generator law, free-product extension, boundary harmonic measure, or entropy theorem
no interpretation of closed words as primitive arithmetic orbits and no dynamical zeta or determinant
no target arithmetic local data, Euler factors, root number, automorphy, target functional equation, target-zero match, Hilbert-Polya operator, or Route B

references.role: primary source for symmetric group walks and the free-group spectral-radius theorem; the two DOI strings identify the same article
authoritative monograph lineage for random walks on infinite graphs and groups

theorem_contract.escape: distance/n tends almost surely to (D-2)/D and obeys a centered CLT with variance 4(D-1)/D^2
theorem_contract.rank_one_boundary: for d=1 the spectrum is arcsine, return is recurrent, speed is zero, and distance/sqrt(n) tends to |N(0,1)|
theorem_contract.spectrum: P is purely absolutely continuous with spectrum [-2sqrt(D-1)/D,2sqrt(D-1)/D]
